text: Objective-probe pilot v1 exited before any objective evaluation: the checkpoint loader compared the canonical Affine wrapper with GridSpec's matrix representation rather than their coefficients. Preserved v1 receipt/log/frozen build. Corrected to exact equality of all 16 coefficients; a new runner test verifies interleaved big-endian physical-coordinate round trip and rejection of a genuinely shifted affine (passed). An intermediate accessor compile failure is retained too. Pilot v2 is separately frozen with identical checkpoint, directions, epsilon schedule, loss tolerance and derivative criterion. The existing dense engine regression exceeded MUnit's default 30-second allowance under load; set the suite's MUnit timeout to 120 seconds and rerun its original numerical assertions. This test-harness limit is separate from the study's unchanged one-hour fitting deadline. No registration formula or optimizer policy changed.
